Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. United Arab Emirates' players walk out to the middle. Followed by Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie who walk out to open for Ireland. Kashif Daud to start with the ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then. 158 is what Ireland need to get off to a winning start. They do a have a side capable of chasing this target down and will surely back themselves. But just like Vriitya Aravind, does UAE have any more surprises left? Do join us for the second essay shortly to find out.

Ireland could not capitalize on the bright start. Ireland bowlers did really well. After the end of Powerplay, they restricted UAE to 34/2 and later the spin dup of Simi Singh and Andy McBrine kept the pressure up. They did not allow the batters to score freely but also could not find wickets in quick succession to make sure the pressure is consistent. Although, all the hard work for undone by some brutal hitting of Vriitya Aravind in the final five overs. Craig Young was the pick with two wickets.

If not for Vriitya Aravind, UAE would have ended the innings on a below-par score. After losing wickets in quick succession up top. Vriitya Aravind and Rohan Mustafa played a crucial knock. Both the players took their time to get going. Although, one thing that remained constant throughout the innings was Vriitya Aravind holding up on end at the crease. He saw his team-mates fall in cluster but that did not bother the young boy at all. He believed in his knock and turned up in the last 5 overs. After 15 over United Arab Emirates were 94/4 and they ended with 157/5. They scored 63 runs in the last 5 and Vriitya Aravind ended the innings on 97*, he missed out on his ton by 3 runs but that won't be on his mind at the moment.
OH MY WORD! What a knock by the 19-year old, Vriitya Aravind. Ireland had no reply for this young boy's hitting. Vriitya Aravind has made sure to give his bowlers something to fight for.
FOUR! What an end to the innings. A length ball, outside off. Vriitya Aravind slashes it through point for a boundary. United Arab Emirates end their innings with 157/5.
FOUR! What a shot! A yorker and on off. Vriitya Aravind works it through third man for a boundary. This is exceptional hitting.
SIX! BANG! Vriitya Aravind is on a roll. Full length, outside off. Vriitya Aravind leans in and smokes it over the point fence for a biggie.
FOUR BYES! A full-length ball, on off. Vriitya Aravind looks to chase it but misses. The ball goes past the pads beats the keeper and races down to the fine leg fence.
Kashif Daud is the new man in.
OUT! CAUGHT! Back of a length, on the body line. Farid pulls it to deep square leg and tries to break the shackles but hits it down the throat of Gareth Delany in the deep, who make no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Gareth Delany b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on off. Vriitya Aravind whips it to mid on for one.
Fuller, wide outside off. Vriitya Aravind dabs it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Vriitya Aravind moves into his 80s. Full length, on the stumps. Vriitya Aravind stands tall and lofts it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
FOUR! The runs keep coming for UAE in the death. A full-length ball, outside off. Vriitya Aravind leans in and drives it through covers. The man in the deep fumbles and concedes a boundary.
Full length, outside off. Vriitya Aravind shuffles across and looks to heave it away but misses.
Length ball, outside off. Vriitya Aravind looks to chase it but misses.
WIDE! This one goes down the leg side. Wided.

Full length, wide outside off. Vriitya Aravind drives it towards cover. Vriitya Aravind wanted two from the moment he hit it. Zawar Farid was unsure about the second run but was forced into it by Vriitya Aravind. Luckily the fielder throws the ball wayward and they take two in the end.
WIDE! Another loosener way outside off. Wide called.
WIDE! Back of a length, outside off and outside the tramline. Vriitya Aravind leaves it alone. Wide called.
FOUR! Nicely played Farid is on the charge now. Full length, wide outside off. Farid leans in and crunches it through point for a boundary. Another good over for United Arab Emirates.
Full and wide outside off. Vriitya Aravind slashes it towards point. Paul Stirling does well to make a stop. They take one.
FOUR! Vriitya Aravind is on a roll. Back of a length, outside off. Vriitya Aravind plays it late and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
LEG BYE! A slower length ball, on the pads. Faird fails to get his bat on ball. The ball dies off his pads. They collect a leg bye.
A length ball, on off, blocked out.
A yorker now, in the blockhole, outside off. Farid looks to chase it but misses it completely.

FOUR! Third boundary of the over. This is what United Arab Emirates are after. A finish on a high. Short ball, on the body. Vriitya Aravind pulls it through square leg for a boundary. Excellent over for United Arab Emirates.
FOUR! What a shot. Vriitya Aravind the young batters is taking the attack to Young. Full length, on middle. Vriitya Aravind gets underneath and lifts it over the bowler's head. Boundary.
A slower bouncer, on leg. Vriitya Aravind looks to chase it but misses.
Back of a length, on off. Farid pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played. A much-needed boundary for United Arab Emirates. Fuller, outside off. Farid stays back and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
LEG BYE! Fuller, on the pads. Vriitya Aravind looks to flick it away but misses. The ball rolls out of the pads. They collect a leg bye.
Full and on leg. Vriitya Aravind flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated full and on off. Farid flicks it towards mid on for one.
Flatter and on off. Vriitya Aravind works it to mid on for one.
Fuller, outside off. Vriitya Aravind drives it through covers for two runs.
Tossed up, on off. Farid pushes it to mid off for a single.
Angled into the pads, with some extra bounce. Farid misses his flick to get hit on his pads.
A real roll of the dice by Andy Balbirnie. He gets Gareth Delany into the attack in the 16th over.
Full length, outside off. Zawar Farid leans in and drives it into cover to get off the mark.
Length ball, on off. Vriitya Aravind pushes it to cover for one.
Zawar Farid is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Craig Young gets his second wicket of the game. This is a huge wicket as Hameed goes back to the dugout. A full-length ball, on off. Basil Hameed stays back and heaves it across the line towards deep square leg. Mark Adair charges towards the ball and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, outside off. Vriitya Aravind drives it through point for one.
Full length, on off. Hameed eases it to mid on for one.
A length ball, on off. Vriitya Aravind pushes it down to long on for a single.
Flatter and on the stumps. Aravind moves to leg side and chops it to point for a single.
Touch short and on off. Aravind makes room and cuts it to covers.
Full, on middle and leg. Hameed clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off. Hameed blocks it out.
Floated, full and on leg. Vriitya Aravind flicks it to mid on for one. FIFTY for the young man. He holds the key for his side in this innings.
LEG BYE! Full and on leg. Hameed gets it out off his pads. They take a leg bye.
Full and on off. Vriitya Aravind defends it to mid off. 13 runs off it.
FOUR! Vriitya Aravind moves to 49. Short and on leg. Vriitya Aravind gets low and slogs it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Touch short and outside off, turning away a hint. Hameed plays late and works it to short third man. One taken.
Leg break, outside off. Vriitya Aravind guides it down to third man for one.
Full and on off. Hameed pushes it through covers for a single.

SIX! BOOM! This is what Basil Hameed is all about. Tossed up, full and on off. Basil Hameed steps forward and heaves it over the cow corner for a maximum. United Arab Emirates need to end the innings on a high.
Tossed up, full and on leg. Vriitya Aravind gets low and sweeps it through square leg for two runs.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Vriitya Aravind plays it back to the bowler.
Flatter and on leg. Hameed clips it to square leg for one.
Full and outside off. Hameed drives it through cover-point for a brace.
Around off, Vriitya Aravind taps it to point for one more.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Hameed comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and on the pads. Hameed clips it through mid-wicket for a single. 7 runs and a wicket off it.
On off, blocked out.
Full, on leg. Vriitya Aravind flicks it towards mid on for one.
FOUR! A freebie and Vriitya Aravind does not hesitate at all. Short and wide outside off. Vriitya Aravind stays back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Full and on the pads. Hameed flicks it through square leg for a single.
Basil Hameed is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED! This is briliant work by the Lorcan Tucker behind the sticks. Angled into the pads. Quicker. Rohan Mustafa comes down the track but misses it completely. Lorcan Tucker does well to gather the ball and clips the bails off quickly. This is a huge wicket for Ireland. Can they build on this?
Commentary.Howout: st Lorcan Tucker b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Runs off every ball since the last two overs! This is full and outside off. Mustafa drives it into covers for one.
Short and on leg. Vriitya Aravind nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Another single now as this is flicked towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up, outside off. Vriitya Aravind opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one.
Angled into the pads. Mustafa clips it through square leg for a single.
Slower through the air, on off. Vriitya Aravind chips it to mid on for a single.
Another single as Vriitya Aravind eases it towards mid on. 9 runs off the over.
Darted on the pads. Mustafa clips it to the leg side. One run.
Fuller and on off. Vriitya Aravind flicks it to mid on for another single.
On middle and leg. Mustafa clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Good running! Flatter and on off. Vriitya Aravind works it down to third man for three runs.
Floated, full and on off. Vriitya Aravind makes room and drives it to wide long off for a brace.
Flatter and on the stumps. Mustafa defends it out to the off side.
A single as this is worked to mid on.
Back of a length, on off. Vriitya Aravind punches it to point.
Tossed up, outside off. Mustafa defends it to cover for a single.
On a length, on off. Vriitya Aravind plays late and steers it to backward point for a single.
Full and on off, blocked back to the bowler.
Andy McBrine comes into the attack now.
Length ball, outside off. Vriitya Aravind leans in and drives it through point for a single.
A short ball, on the body, Vriitya Aravind pulls it to deep square leg for a brace.
Back of a length, on off. Rohan Mustafa guides it down to third man for a single.
Fuller, on off. Vriitya Aravind pushes it to mid on for a run.
Fuller, wide outside off. Rohan Mustafa throws his bat at it and hits it towards mid off for a single.
Full length, on leg. Rohan Mustafa nudges it to the leg side. No run.
Full, on the stumps. Vriitya Aravind stays back and defends it to cover. Not in the gap though. At the end of Powerplay. United Arab Emirates are 34/2.
Tossed up, on off. Vriitya Aravind blocks it towards mid off.
Fuller, on off. Mustafa helps it towards mid on for a single.
WIDE! Angled down the leg side. Mustafa leaves it alone. Wided.
Looped up, around off. This one turns away off the deck. Mustafa looks to chase it but misses. This was very close.
A single as this is eased down to mid off.
WIDE! Quicker and flatter, sliding down leg. Mustafa looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
Fuller and on the pads. Vriitya Aravind flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, around off. Mustafa dabs it to backward point.
Full length, wide outside off. Mustafa does not chase it. Wide called.
Fuller, on the pads. Vriitya Aravind flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Vriitya Aravind gets lucky this time. It is full, on middle and leg. Vriitya Aravind gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played. A full-length ball, on off. Vriitya Aravind drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Full length, on off. Vriitya Aravind pushes it to cover.
Rohan Mustafa is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Gareth Delany with a blinder. What a catch. Craig Young strikes immediately. A full-length ball, on off. Waseem Muhammad hits it high in the air off the outside edge. It goes over point. Gareth Delany runs backwards and takes a good catch over his shoulder. He cannot believe how he hold onto the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Gareth Delany b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, outside off. Vriitya Aravind drives it to the off side. Not in the gap. 11 runs off it. A good over for United Arab Emirates.
Back of a length, outside off. Vriitya Aravind cuts it through backward point. The fielder does well to make a stop. They take two.
WIDE! Josh Little now comes 'round the wicket and starts with a loosener. A length ball, wide outside off. Vriitya Aravind leaves it alone. Wide called.
FOUR! This is much better from Vriitya Aravind. A full-length ball, outside off. Vriitya Aravind leans in and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Vriitya Aravind leaves it alone.
FOUR! Streaky! Good length, outside off. Vriitya Aravind looks to chase it but only manages to outside edge it past the slip and into the boundary at third man.
Length and on off, blocked out.
LEG BYE! A length ball, on leg. Vriitya Aravind looks to flick it away but misses. It rolls out of the pads. A leg bye collected.
Three dots in a row now! This is really good bowling by Adair. On a length, around off. Aravind pushes it out.
A length ball, on off. Vriitya Aravind blocks it out solidly.
Good length, on off. Vriitya Aravind gets it to point off the outer half.
A length ball, on off. Waseem Muhammad taps it to point for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Waseem Muhammad sways away from the line of the delivery.
Full length, outside off. Vriitya Aravind looks to go for the booming drive but misses. Big swing and a miss this time.
Back of a length, outside off, shaping in late. Vriitya Aravind stays back and looks to chase it but gets beaten.
Full length, on off, bit to straight this time. Waseem Muhammad pushes it to covers for a quick single.
Good length, on off. Waseem Muhammad plays it back towards the bowler. Little fails to pick it up but it goes straight to the man at mid on.
Length and on the stumps. Waseem Muhammad defends it out solidly.
Good-length ball, outside off, shaping across the right-hander. Waseem Muhammad leaves it alone for the keeper.
Vriitya Aravind is the new man in. Also, Josh Little to share the new ball.

OUT! TIMBER! Mark Adair draws the first blood and sends back Suri on a golden duck. This is a peach of a delivery to get rid of Suri. A full-length ball, outside off. swinging in late. Suri gets undone by the movement. He tries to push it through the off side but misses it completely. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps.
Fuller, on the pads. Waseem Muhammad flicks it to square leg for just a single.
FOUR! First runs off the blade for United Arab Emirates. A full-length ball, on leg. Waseem Muhammad stays back and flicks it aerially to deep square leg for a boundary.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Waseem Muhammad tucks it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! A length ball, sliding down leg. Waseem Muhammad tries to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
A length ball, on the stumps. Waseem Muhammad watchfully blocks it out.
A dot to start with! A good-length ball, outside off. This is shapes away a hint. Waseem Muhammad leans forward and tries to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.

The game is set to begin. The Ireland players stride out to the middle. Followed by Waseem Muhammad and Chirag Suri who walk out to open for United Arab Emirates. Mark Adair to start with the new ball.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland says the side would look to gel well and start on a good note. Mentions, he would've loved to bowl first anyways/ Adds, the wicket is dry here and they would look to restrict the opposition to a low score.

Ahmed Raza, the skipper of United Arab Emirates, is in for a chat. He says, they will bat first. Adds putting the runs on the board is really important and hopes the team can defend this target. Laughs and says he did not win a single toss in the last series and have managed to defend every single time. He hopes the players do well.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Andy Balbirnie (C), Mark Adair, Gareth Delany, George Dockrell, Shane Getkate, Josh Little, Andy McBrine, Simi Singh, Paul Stirling, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Craig Young.

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Waseem Muhammad, Chirag Suri, Vriitya Aravind (WK), Rohan Mustafa, Kashif Daud, Ahmed Raza (C), Zahoor Khan, Karthik Meiyappan, Junaid Siddique, Zawar Farid, Basil Hameed.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of United Arab Emirates. They have elected to BAT first.

UAE are coming into this campaign much high on confidence after an excellent quadrangular T20 series. They have a unit with a lot of potential and can turn the game on it’s head if required. Ireland, on the flip side, are a side with a lot of experience on their back. Even though they haven’t been in top form recently, one cannot write them off. This should be a mouth-watering clash. Fasten you seat belts, as we move closer to the toss.

Hello and a warm welcome to game number 3 of the T20 World Cup Qualifiers. This game sees a clash between two heavyweights of Group A, Ireland and United Arab Emirates. These two are the favourites to lift the title and this opening fixture of the campaign is a vital one. Both teams would be eager to get off to a winning start but who will it be? Stay tuned to find out.
